predecessors.name: Heian Japan
predecessors.text: 'the Mutsu and Dewa Province' north of the Sendai plain: the Kiyohara lands held under the imperial governor of Mutsu since the Former Nine Years' War

successors.name: Kamakura shogunate
successors.text: the whole realm: 'Yoritomo entered Hiraizumi' on 3 October 1189

ledger.x: 1087: Fujiwara no Kiyohira founds the Hiraizumi realm after the Gosannen War.
1189: the Northern Fujiwara destroyed; Ōshū passes to Yoritomo.

wars.name: Gosannen War
wars.outcome: 'Military stalemate'; 'In the end, Iehira and Narihira were killed'; Fujiwara no Kiyohira, who 'helped' Yoshiie, emerged as lord of the former Kiyohara lands and founded the Hiraizumi realm (1087, Northern Fujiwara page).

wars.name: Battle of Ōshū
wars.outcome: 'The Battle of Ōshū resulted in the destruction of the Northern Fujiwara clan'; Hiraizumi burned 2 October 1189, Yasuhira killed 14 October.

certainty.note: The southern limit against the court's provinces of Mutsu and Dewa is administrative, not a border; the northern limit (Tsugaru, Ezo trade) is not on the pages.
